# DPlanner Photography

> Professional photography studio in Yemetu, Ibadan, Nigeria, led by founder Samuel Damilare. Specializing in studio portraits with guaranteed 24-hour turnaround, creative concept sessions, and complete photo & film coverage for traditional and white weddings across Ibadan, Lagos, and nationwide. Rated 4.9 from 46 verified Google reviews.

## Core Facts & Verified Profile

- **Brand:** DPlanner Photography (umbrella brand: DPlanner)
- **Lead Photographer:** Samuel Damilare

## Services & Published Pricing

### Studio & Portrait Photography (Yemetu, Ibadan)
- **Standard Studio Portraits:** ₦2,000 per edited picture. Controlled studio strobes, backdrop selection, natural skin retouching, high-resolution digital files. Standard delivery within 24 hours.
- **Same-day Express Delivery:** +₦500 per picture.
- **Creative Concept Sessions:** From ₦3,000 per picture. Pre-session moodboard, artistic lighting setups, guided creative posing, fine editorial color grading.

### 2026 Wedding Photography & Film Packages (Valid until 31 Dec 2026)
- **Essential Package:** ₦180,000 (was ₦200,000). One-day photo + film, ceremony + reception coverage, couple + family portraits, edited high-resolution images, digital delivery (Google Drive).
- **Classic Package (Most Popular):** ₦250,000 (was ₦300,000). Everything in Essential plus bride + groom preparation, cinematic highlight film, 12×16 framed portrait, and social wedding reel (Instagram/TikTok).
- **Signature Album Package:** ₦450,000 (was ₦550,000). Everything in Classic plus pre-wedding studio session, 16×20 framed portrait, Album Collection included (12×24 flush-mount synthetic photobook, 50 designed pages, in a leather presentation briefcase, mini keepsake photobook & custom anniversary calendar), and priority delivery.
- **Album Collection Add-on:** ₦180,000 (was ₦200,000). 12×24 flush-mount synthetic photobook (50 designed pages), leather presentation briefcase, mini keepsake photobook, and custom anniversary calendar. Adds to Essential or Classic.

### Birthdays, Corporate & Private Events
- Full documentary coverage for birthday celebrations, milestone anniversaries, corporate conferences, and AGMs. Quotes provided via WhatsApp.

## Turnaround & Delivery Guarantees

- **Studio Portraits:** Standard delivery within 24 hours of client photo selection. Same-day express delivery: +₦500 per picture.
- **Wedding Highlight Films:** Delivered within 1 week after the wedding.
- **Edited Wedding Galleries:** Delivered within 3–4 weeks after the wedding.

## Booking & Reservation Terms

- **Studio Sessions:** 50% deposit secures session time. Balance due before final delivery.
- **Weddings & Major Events:** 50% non-refundable deposit locks the date on our calendar. Dates held first-come, first-served. Balance due before final delivery.
